Welcome to 66 Charlesland Grove, a beautifully presented two-bedroom, one-bathroom ground floor apartment offering bright, spacious accommodation in the heart of the ever-popular Charlesland development.

Designed with comfortable modern living in mind, this well-maintained home features a generous open-plan living and dining area with direct access to a private, sun-filled terrace—an ideal space for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying your morning coffee. The well-appointed kitchen is both practical and functional, while the two spacious bedrooms provide comfortable accommodation, complemented by a stylish family bathroom.

Further enhancing the appeal of this excellent home is the convenience of designated parking and its sought-after ground floor position, offering easy access throughout.

Ideally located, 66 Charlesland Grove is within easy reach of an excellent range of local amenities including shops, cafés, schools, sports clubs, and scenic coastal walks. Greystones Town Centre, the DART station, and a variety of transport links are all close by, making this an ideal choice for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors seeking a quality property in a prime location.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
